title: Ignore Policy
statement: Implement `solve(escapes)`. Each escape is `fix`, `narrow`, or `ignore`. Return a list of decisions: `fix` stays `fix`, `narrow` stays `narrow`, and `ignore` becomes `reject`. A blanket ignore is not an allowed outcome.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A type-ignore comment that nobody owns becomes a permanent hole.

editorial: A type-ignore comment that nobody owns becomes a permanent hole. The allowed responses to a checker error are to fix the code or to narrow the value so the error goes away. Ignoring is the choice this policy refuses.
